quote: Chile’s Ministry of Public Works (MOP) issued the supreme decree awarding ISA VÍAS the Río Bueno–Puerto Montt (Ruta de los Lagos) concession, a project that involves the modernization of 129 km of highway in southern Chile. This project has a projected capex of USD 821 million (~COP 3 trillion). As this is the concession of an existing highway, ISA VÍAS took over the project in July 2026, with the construction phase scheduled to begin in 2031.
note: Opened ISA Q2 2026 English financial results; Río Bueno–Puerto Montt USD 821m / 129 km / construction from 2031 confirmed.
